checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Blue-jacket pedestrian on right is absent
must.why: The man in the blue jacket is gone.

must.item: Former area has plausible continuous background without silhouette/smearing
must.why: The road, bike lane and sidewalk fill looks clean, though the red-tinted bike lane patch and painted bike symbols are invented.

must.item: Shops, layout, sunny lighting consistent with source
must.why: The shops and light match, but a new woman appears on the left sidewalk, new bike symbols appear on the road, and the dark-clothed person by the right wall is gone.
The framing and size are unchanged.

faults.what: A new woman in a grey top and jeans appears on the left sidewalk. She was not in the original. The user asked for people to be removed, not added.
New bike-lane markings and symbols are painted on the road, and the right bike lane has a red tint. None of this was in the original.
The second pedestrian in dark clothing, next to the blue-jacket man, was also removed. The user did not ask for this.
The shop sign text is slightly altered (a red sign reads differently) and there are small changes to the cars and sidewalk on the right.

summary: The blue-jacket man is removed cleanly, but the edit added a new woman on the left sidewalk, invented road markings, and also removed a second person, so it does not match "keep everything else the same".
